blocks.text: Keep your kitchen running smoothly with garbage disposal repair services when you need them in Alamo Heights, TX. Your garbage disposal helps keep your trash down and prevents your kitchen from attracting pests like flies and rodents. When your garbage disposal is working well, your daily kitchen routine is significantly more convenient. But it’s easy to take for granted. When it’s not working correctly, or at all, you’ll want a garbage disposal replacement or repair as soon as possible.

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’re a full-service plumbing company, which means we can install a new garbage disposal, repair a malfunctioning unit, or put in a replacement. We can even upgrade a unit that isn’t up to the demands of a growing family. No matter what the issue with your disposal, contact Rosenberg Plumbing & Air to get an honest, lasting solution.
When to Call for Garbage Disposal Repair Help

If your garbage disposal is clogging all the time or making strange noises, it’s likely time to get a plumber in to take a look. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we won’t just unclog the unit and call it a day. Instead, we’ll take the time to track down the root cause so that we can make suggestions that will permanently solve the problem. Did you know that garbage disposals come in different sizes? They also have different types of grinders and varying power levels.

Get a licensed plumber to walk you through the options for a garbage disposal replacement if that’s what you need. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we’ll help you decide by giving you all the information about what’s causing your garbage disposal to struggle and how to prevent it in the future. It could be something simple like tossing fibrous scraps like celery stalks in the trash or compost, not the sink. Or, it could be that your unit is aging and needs replacing.

Frequent clogs might mean you need a garbage disposal repair like putting in new grinding plates. But if your disposal is more than 10 years old, replacement is probably best. Many repairs are pricey enough that the cost of a replacement is more economical. Most plumbers recommend garbage disposal replacement after 10 years since the average life of these appliances is 8-10 years.
